briefing: NASDAQ +1.3% and S&P 500 +0.6% signal a risk-on day, but portfolio cash is only $89.29 — far below the $500 threshold needed to responsibly open a new position, even with 3 slots open. Holding all 7 existing positions and letting stop-loss/profit-target rules manage them automatically.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Even on a bullish day, a portfolio can't chase every opportunity if it doesn't have enough cash on hand — here, only $89 was available, well short of the $500 minimum needed to size a new position responsibly. Staying disciplined about position sizing, rather than forcing a trade with insufficient capital, protects the portfolio from over-concentration in tiny, poorly-sized bets.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 即使在市場向好的日子，若現金儲備不足，投資組合亦無法把握每個機會——今日可用現金僅89美元，遠低於建立新倉位所需的500美元門檻。堅持紀律，不因現金不足而勉強落注，有助避免組合過度集中於規模過小、配置欠佳的持倉。

market_education.summary_en: Markets traded higher today with the NASDAQ outpacing the S&P 500, consistent with a broad risk-on tone favoring growth and tech names. No specific news catalysts were provided for today's session, so this move appears driven by general market sentiment rather than a single headline event. Investors continued to favor equities over safer assets given the positive breadth across major indices.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市造好，納指升幅跑贏標普500指數，反映市場整體風險偏好偏向增長型及科技股。今日交易時段未有提供具體新聞觸發因素，故此走勢較大機會是受整體市場情緒帶動,而非單一消息刺激。在主要指數普遍向好下，投資者繼續傾向持有股票多於避險資產。
